antibody.notes: As described in the August 2015 antibody characterization standards document, the standards for an epitope-tagged antibody are discussed elsewhere (i.e. in the July 2011 ChIP-seq standards document). On page 4 it says, "The recommended control for experiments with epitope-tagged factors is an immunoprecipitation using the same antibody against the epitope tag in otherwise identical cells which do not contain the expression construct or which do not express the tagged factor." Hence, the lack of an IgG-control is acceptable here.
